svg.title: How travel footage becomes a film
svg.desc: Five stages: recover the trip, find the story and record narration, assemble picture and sound, review and revise, approve and deliver. Project memory preserves context and decisions. Tools shown are examples, not bundled integrations.
svg.text: How travel footage becomes a film
Your memories and voice. An agent coordinating the tools.
